How this simplified model works

A weighted runoff coefficient estimates the share of rain that becomes surface flow: 0.15 for permeable land and 0.90 for impervious land. A conceptual storage reservoir delays that water; faster engineered drainage shortens the delay. Downstream ponding accumulates whenever inflow is greater than drain capacity.

This is an educational comparison model, not a site-specific engineering calculation. Real design requires local topography, soil, rainfall curves, drain geometry and calibrated hydrology.

Try this: choose “Natural hillside,” then “Developed upstream.” Keep the same rain and drain capacity. The difference is caused by land cover and drainage speed.
